title: GlusterFS SPLIT-BRAIN Detected

annotations.description: CRITICAL: GlusterFS has detected split-brain! Immediate intervention required.

_comment: for=0m: fires immediately, no debounce — split-brain is data-integrity critical and worth a false positive over a missed real one. See incident report 03 for a real false-positive this rule caught (health-check command itself failed, not an actual split-brain) and the script fix that followed.
